final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT il.InvoiceId, c.State, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM InvoiceLine AS il JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY il.InvoiceId, c.State), step2 AS (SELECT State, SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM step1 GROUP BY State), step3 AS (SELECT s1.InvoiceId, s1.State, s1.record_count, 1.0 * s1.record_count / s2.total_count AS quotient FROM step1 AS s1 JOIN step2 AS s2 ON CAST(s1.State AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY = CAST(s2.State AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY), step4 AS (SELECT State, AVG(quotient) AS average_quotient FROM step3 GROUP BY State) SELECT s3.InvoiceId, s3.State, s3.record_count, s3.quotient, s3.quotient - s4.average_quotient AS difference FROM step3 AS s3 JOIN step4 AS s4 ON CAST(s3.State AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY = CAST(s4.State AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY WHERE s3.quotient > s4.average_quotient ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10
